reason: I already pay for a charter package that does my quoting and holds years of bookings and customer history. I'm not tearing that out for a brand-new company with no customers, especially heading into school excursion and end-of-year season.
objection: Moving years of data for an unproven product. If the migration goes wrong or the company folds, I'm the one left scrambling with buses booked and no records. I also can't tell from this if it handles proper charter quoting and Australian accreditation, or if it's generic fleet software with a bus logo on it.
would_change_my_mind: If they moved all my existing data across for free, ran it side by side with my current system through a quiet period, and showed me charter quoting and accreditation records working the way an Australian operator actually needs, with a couple of operators my size already on it.
